A [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] was a member of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] that served as the '''[[Lorekeeper]]''' who passed on her knowledge to younger members of the clan.
